# MatchMax

> Hong Kong's tutoring marketplace — instantly matching parents and students to verified DSE, IB, IGCSE, and AP tutors.

MatchMax connects Hong Kong families with vetted local tutors. Parents post a case and get auto-matched to the best-fit tutors; tutors build a verified profile to receive leads.

## Pages

- [Home](/en): Overview, featured tutors, live stats, and parent reviews.
- [Browse tutors](/en/tutors): Directory of verified Hong Kong tutors filterable by subject and district.
- [Become a tutor](/en/become-a-tutor): How tutors join the MatchMax marketplace.
- [Tutor Playbook](/en/tutor-playbook): Parent-relations and etiquette playbook for MatchMax tutors.
